## History

Born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) grew up as an unloved orphan before being taken in at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). After succeeding academically and briefly working as a teacher at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, she resigned her position so she could attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) when [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) agreed to move in with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). During her time teaching, she formed a close bond with her imaginative student [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and later visited [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where she helped Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for her reunion and subsequent wedding to Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). Following the wedding ceremony, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shared a quiet, romantic moment with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) as she prepared to begin a new chapter of her life.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P16](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), +19 more_

## Quotes

> "In the years to come thy memory will shine like a star over my lonely life, as that last story we read together says. Diana, wilt thou give me a lock of thy jet-black tresses in parting to treasure forevermore?"
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010)

> "Fare thee well, my beloved friend. Henceforth we must be as strangers though living side by side. But my heart will ever be faithful to thee."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P12](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0012)

> "That is all there is left in life for me, now that my friend has been ruthlessly torn from me. In school I can look at her and muse over days departed."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017)

> “I think he has only been its nominal head for many years,” said Anne. “He is a very old man; his nephews are really at the head of the institution.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P35](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0035)

> “If I had been the boy you sent for,” said Anne wistfully, “I’d be able to help you so much now and spare you in a hundred ways. I could find it in my heart to wish I had been, just for that.”
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P40](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0040)

## Relationships

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

Shirley and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) initially engaged in a fierce academic rivalry during their school years, competing for top honors such as the Avery Scholarship and the school medal. Over time, their dynamic softened as they shared significant milestones, culminating in a quiet, romantic moment together after Miss Lavendar's wedding.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), +9 more_

- Rival of — academic rivals in school  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>

### [Allan](../character/allan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--shirley.md)

Mrs. Allan built a trusting friendship with Shirley, confiding in her about the loss of her deceased baby.

- Friend of — confided in her about her deceased baby (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVI Around the Bend P38](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0038)</sub>

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--shirley.md)

Charlotta the Fourth admires and confides in Shirley, sharing her deep concerns about Miss Lavendar's mood and despondency. Shirley relies on Charlotta's help when visiting [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where the two work together to gather strawberries, prepare for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's visit, and assist with wedding preparations.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), +33 more_

- Friend of — admires her and confides in her (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--shirley.md)

Shirley and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) are close childhood friends who swore eternal friendship to one another. Their bond remains steadfast through periods of enforced separation in their youth, shared grief over Shirley leaving her teaching job, and pivotal life moments such as [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) confiding her engagement to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) and working alongside Shirley to prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for a wedding.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), +29 more_

- Friend of — close childhood friends who swore eternal friendship (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVI Around the Bend P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P0](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0000)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--shirley.md)

Shirley maintains a warm friendship with Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), frequently visiting [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to spend time in her garden. Upon learning of Miss Lavendar's despondency, Shirley spends a week staying with her to offer cheer, eventually helping her prepare for her emotional reunion and eventual marriage to [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), +17 more_

- Friend of — close friends who visit each other (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P34](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0034)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--shirley.md)

Shirley acts as both a teacher and mentor to [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), fostering a bond based on mutual affection and admiration for his creative mind and imaginative compositions. [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) frequently shows his appreciation by bringing her wild orchids, accompanying her on walks to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), and visiting her as she prepares to leave for college.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), +31 more_
